text:
toni: hi all — first day! quick checklist: okta sign-in succeeded but my dashboard shows zero apps, google drive doesn't show the 'eng-squad' folder, 1Password invite link returns 'invalid token', and trying to register a passkey (Touch ID) gives 'Registration failed' on the company laptop. who do I bug? :confused:
it-support: welcome @toni :tada: use your corporate email? which macOS and browser version? can you paste the exact error strings for the passkey flow?
toni: yes toni@redwood.com. macOS 12.6, Safari 16.4. passkey popup just: "Registration failed. Try again." no extra code. 1Password email shows but clicking the link says invalid token.
onboarding-bot: Welcome! If provisioning hasn't finished within 15m, ping @it-support and @idp-engineer. Docs: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/account-setup
idp-engineer: tagging — i see a delayed SCIM job for toni@redwood.com that failed to map groups due to a new mapping rule. that would leave apps unassigned and Drive ACLs missing. i'll run a manual resync and then reissue the 1Password invite.
lina: if you need Drive access immediate, ask your manager to share the folder link; i can also add temporary access.
toni: my manager shared but it still requests access when i open.
idp-engineer: i granted direct access and re-ran SCIM. also re-sent 1Password invite (fresh token). check spam and try the invite link in a private window.
toni: 1Password link worked now :thumbsup: Drive opens ok. passkey still failing though — same "Try again".
it-support: odd that Touch ID fails in Safari. quick checks: 1) confirm System Preferences -> Security & Privacy -> "Allow websites to use Touch ID" (or Biometrics) is enabled; 2) try toggling Keychain Access -> First Aid; 3) test with Chrome or try using an external YubiKey to see if it's a platform passkey issue.
toni: Biometrics setting was off. turned it on and reloaded Okta. passkey registration now succeeds. thanks!
it-support: great. root cause summary: SCIM groupsync failed due to mapping change; idp-engineer forced resync and reissued 1Password invite; Drive ACL fixed; passkey issue was macOS biometric permission. next steps: idp-engineer to revert the problematic mapping change and add a guard in the pipeline.
idp-engineer: will add a validation step to prevent that mapping from being pushed without a migration script.
toni: amazing, thanks y'all. excited to be here :)
it-support: welcome aboard, @toni — closing the loop. if anything else pops up DM us directly. :white_check_mark:
